python3 -c "
import openpyxl,copy
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('book.xlsx')
ws=wb['Sales']
print([(r.sqref,[x.formula for x in r.rules]) for r in ws.conditional_formatting], ws.auto_filter.ref, ws.print_area, ws.freeze_panes)
h={r:ws.row_dimensions[r].height for r in range(1,23)}
ws.insert_rows(11)
for r in range(22,10,-1):
  ws.row_dimensions[r+1].height=h[r]
ws.row_dimensions[11].height=h[10]
for c in range(1,7):
  s=ws.cell(10,c);d=ws.cell(11,c);d._style=copy.copy(s._style)
for c,v in zip('ABCDEF',['West','Dana Lee',40,125,'=C11*D11','=E11*CommissionRate']): ws[c+'11']=v
for c in 'CEF': ws[c+'23']=f'=SUM({c}2:{c}22)'
wb.defined_names['SalesRevenue'].attr_text='Sales!\$E\$2:\$E\$22'
s=wb['Summary']
s['B3']='=Sales!E23';s['B4']='=Sales!F23'
s['B6']='=SUMIF(Sales!A2:A22,\"North\",Sales!E2:E22)'
wb.save('book.xlsx')
"
